name: Minimap
author: Xk
description: A minimap of the floor, with every room and its exits colored by how they open.
longDescription:
This mod will show you every tiles that is generated on your floor
Still in WIP but it's usable
Press M to open/close your map
Show where is the gate and what kind of gate it is (Kill/Plate/Open/Breakable)
How much time you're spending in a dungeon
How much gold you're making in a dungeon

Color code: 
Orange = Trigger Gate (Open the gate with a trigger (example: plate))
Purple = Kill Gate (Gate will open after you kill spawned npc)
Cyan = Breakable Gate (You have to break a prop to get to the gate)
Green = It's already open, rush !
Red = Closed Gate
Grey = Unknown Gate

Color red and grey won't stay here once every gates are fixed
